This paper consists of 4 printed pages. Candidates should check the question paper to ensure
that all pages are printed as indicated and no questions are missing.
 1. The extract below shows a spread sheet used to record books stored in the library. The books
 are borrowed by students under the plan of Short and long loan borrow type. A short loan
 borrow type attracts a fee of Ksh 7.50 per day while the Long loan borrow type attracts a fee of
 Ksh 5 per day.
(a)(i)Create a worksheet and save the spreadsheet as Library (1 Mark)
 (ii) Insert a label In the row 1 merge the cells center the label (1 Mark)
 (iii) Insert the data in the sheet as shown above (19 Marks)
 (iv) Name the worksheet as Charge (1 Mark)
 (b) (i) Using the formula or functions calculate the days borrowed and charge for every Individual
 student (8 Marks)
 (ii) Create a table showing the total charge for each category and use formula to calculate the
 values (8 Marks)
 (iii). Create a Pie chart Based on b(ii) Above (4 Marks)
 (c) (i) Copy the Data in the worksheet charge to a new worksheet and rename the worksheet as
 category subtotal (1Mark)
 (ii) Sort the data in the worksheet in the part c(i) in ascending values of borrow type (2 Mark)
 (iii) Insert the subtotals in the sorted worksheet category subtotal based on Category and Charge
 (3 Mark)
 (d) Print charge worksheet, Category subtotal and the Chart (3 Marks)
2. ABC cleaning services offers cleaning services to clients categorized as Small, Medium,
 Corporate and Big.
 The table in figure 1 represents the charges to their clients and number of cleaners depending
 on the client. The Administrative Charge(Ksh)/Day and Consumable fee(Ksh)/day are the charges
 made to the clients
 Category Administrative Consumable No of Cleaners
 Charge(Ksh)/Day fee(Ksh)/day
 Small 5000 1000 4
 Medium 10000 1500 6
 Corporate 15000 2000 8
 Big 20000 2500 10
 Figure 1
 The cleaners are paid a fixed amount of 500 shilling per day on each cleaning day.
 Invoices are sent to Clients on monthly bases
 The following tables shows data for the client and invoice table
(a) (i) Create a database and save the database as cleaning (1 Mark)
 (ii) Create the two tables Client and Invoice (2 Marks)
 (iii)Create the relationship between the two tables (1 Mark)
 (iv) Fill in the data in the two tables (10 Marks)
(b) (i)Create a query to show Total charge made to the Clients with the following fields. CLIENT_ ID,
 CLIENT_NAME, CATEGORY, TELEPHONE, CITY, Cleaning Date, Month, Year, Administrative
 Charge (Ksh), Consumable Fee And Total Charge. Save the Query as invoice
 (14 Marks)
 (ii) Create a query Based on the query in Part b(i) above with the following fields CLIENT'S ID,
 CLIENT_NAME, CATEGORY, TELEPHONE, CITY, Cleaning, Date, Month, Year, Administrative
 Charge(Ksh), Consumable Fee And Total Charge. Save the Query as client invoice it should filter
 out the fields by criteria of CLIENT_ID, Month and year
 (3 Marks)
 (iii) Create a query Based on the query in Part b(i) above which should show total annual
 invoices with individual monthly totals save the query as annual summary
 (5 Marks)
 (c) (I) Create a report based on b(ii) Showing all the appropriate summaries Save the report as
 monthly invoice (5 Marks)
 See sample below
 (ii) Create a report based on and b(ii) Showing all the appropriate summaries save the report as
 annualsummary (5 Marks)
